```{python}
#| label: tbl-1
#| tbl-cap: "Summary of CASPER sampling sites."

from plot_sample_summary import generate_sampling_sites_table

table1 = generate_sampling_sites_table(
    site_data,
    save_path='../tables/sampling_sites.tsv'
)

def format_sites_table_html(df):
    """Render region headers as bold rows."""
    rows = []
    current_region = None
    cols = ['Sampling site', 'NWSS sewershed ID', 'Location type', 'Sample type', 'Approx. population served',
            'Sequencing partner', 'Sample collection start date', 'Sample collection end date',
            'Number of samples', 'Median read pairs', 'Median sampling interval (days)', 'Median turnaround (days)']
    for _, row in df.iterrows():
        if row['region'] != current_region:
            current_region = row['region']
            rows.append({col: f"**{current_region}**" if col == 'Sampling site' else '' for col in cols})
        rows.append({col: str(row[col]) if pd.notna(row[col]) else '' for col in cols})
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)

display_df = format_sites_table_html(table1)
Markdown(display_df.to_markdown(index=False))
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-s-pipeline-benchmark
#| fig-cap: "Read-level accuracy of the vertebrate-infecting virus (VV) identification pipeline on simulated reads. Reads were simulated from genomes the pipeline's reference index contains (in-index) and from genomes of the same species absent from it (out-of-index), then scored against the genome each read came from. Each read is filed at the finest taxonomic rank its assignment gets right, so a read assigned to the correct genus but the wrong species counts as correct at genus. Incorrect pools reads assigned above genus, assigned to the wrong lineage, and not recovered at all."

import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path('..').resolve() / 'benchmark'))
from assignment_evaluation.plot_composition import (
    plot_pipeline_benchmark, print_benchmark_statistics,
)

print_benchmark_statistics()

fig = plot_pipeline_benchmark(save_path='../figures/pipeline_benchmark.png')
plt.show()
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-s-ribodepletion
#| fig-cap: "Effect of the rRNA-depletion step on vertebrate-infecting virus (VV) recovery. A reagent preparation error omitted the Pan-Bacterial RiboPOOLs probes from SecureBio (SB) libraries whose samples were collected between 13 May and 1 July 2025 inclusive (22 samples; Methods), marked by the shaded band. University of Missouri (MU) libraries are never rRNA-depleted, so in the MU panels the same interval is outlined rather than filled. Boston Deer Island Treatment Plant (DITP) North and South were split between the two laboratories over this period, so for those two systems the MU series is a control on the same wastewater. Each panel shows rRNA fraction (grey, dashed, left axis, linear) and VV read fraction (lab colour, solid, right axis, log) per sample, unsmoothed and connected in collection order, with both scales shared across panels; VV read fraction is VV read pairs from the dedicated VV pipeline divided by total read pairs, and rRNA fraction is from the shallow Kraken profiling subsample. Annotations give the ratio of median VV read fraction inside the window to outside it. Miami-Dade Central District Wastewater Treatment Plant (CDWWTP) was sequenced by SB only, so it has no MU panel. Values for the affected samples are tabulated in @tbl-s-ribodepletion-omitted."

from plot_ribodepletion_effect import (
    plot_ribodepletion_effect, prepare_ribodepletion_data,
    print_ribodepletion_statistics,
)

ribodepletion_data = prepare_ribodepletion_data(
    kraken_data, site_data, vv_family_data
)
print_ribodepletion_statistics(ribodepletion_data)

fig, axes = plot_ribodepletion_effect(
    ribodepletion_data, save_path='../figures/ribodepletion_effect.png'
)
plt.show()
```

```{python}
        sewershed_df['Site'] if 'Site' in sewershed_df.columns else sewershed_df['site_name'],

        lambda s: f'{s} ({sewershed_lookup[s]})' if s in sewershed_lookup else s
    )

    display(Markdown(display_df.to_markdown(index=False)))
```

```{python}
#| label: tbl-s-pipeline-benchmark
#| tbl-cap: "Accuracy of the vertebrate-infecting virus (VV) identification pipeline on reads simulated from three panels of reference genomes: genomes the reference index contains, genomes of the same species absent from it, and the most abundant non-VV organisms in this study's libraries plus the human genome. Reads are counted at the finest rank their assignment gets right. Percentages are of the read pairs simulated for that panel; the genus column includes the species-correct reads, so it and the incorrect column sum to 100%. Incorrect also covers reads the pipeline did not recover. On the negative panel any VV assignment is a false positive, equivalent to 89 spurious read pairs per billion wastewater read pairs (95% upper bound 1,242)."

import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path('..').resolve() / 'benchmark'))
from export_benchmark_table import build_benchmark_table

benchmark_table = build_benchmark_table()
benchmark_table.to_csv('../tables/pipeline_benchmark.tsv', sep='\t', index=False)

display(Markdown(benchmark_table.to_markdown(index=False)))
```

```{python}
#| label: tbl-s-pipeline-benchmark-family
#| tbl-cap: "Accuracy of vertebrate-infecting virus identification by virus family, for each positive panel. Taxa are those the family contributes to that panel; percentages are of the read pairs simulated for the family in that panel. As in @tbl-s-pipeline-benchmark, the genus column includes the species-correct reads, so it and the incorrect column sum to 100%, and incorrect covers reads assigned no finer than family, reads assigned to the wrong lineage, and reads not recovered at all."

import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path('..').resolve() / 'benchmark'))
```
